title: wazan: Tajik Poetry Analyzer
description:
wazan (formerly tajikpoemanalyzer; Persian/Tajik vazn, ‘metre’). Corpus and analysis tool for Tajik poetry, with a focus on free verse (shiʼri nou) alongside classical structure. It provides syllable and stanza analysis, experimental ʿarūḍ scansion against the derived Persian metres (incl. vaṣl, overlength and rubāʿī variants) with a Nimāʾī rule for metrical free verse, phonetic recognition of qāfiya and radīf, free-verse metrics such as enjambment and line-length variation, neologism detection against a lexicon of more than 68,000 word forms, lexical diversity (MTLD after McCarthy & Jarvis 2010), thematic analysis, and export of a derived feature layer.

Data policy: poem texts are never distributed with this software. Full texts remain with their rights holders and are excluded from the repository. Only a derived feature layer is shareable, in which individual poems are identified by hash and cannot be reconstructed.
